name: Mangrove crabs
desc: Small crabs of mangrove mud that feed on fallen mangrove leaves and so move mangrove nutrients into the mud and other animals.
about: The Sesarmidae are a family of crabs, previously included in the Grapsidae by many authors. Several species, namely in Geosesarma, Metopaulias, and Sesarma, are true terrestrial crabs.
